hero_sub: AuraFlux is a spec-driven production environment. Peaks finds the moment using YouTube Most Replayed, Twitch chat spikes, and Kick CCV. The pipeline runs only the portals that job needs. Then you publish from the member portal.

portals.name: Intake & intelligence
portals.description: Source analysis and job setup. For Peaks, this starts from YouTube Most Replayed, Twitch chat, or Kick CCV windows you select.

portals.name: Script & voice
portals.description: Optional. Runs when the job spec orders script or TTS. Not required for every Short.

portals.name: Edit & assembly
portals.description: Cutting, reframing, captions, and timeline assembly for the Short.

portals.name: Quality assurance
portals.description: Portal QA marks compliant or non-compliant before the job advances.

portals.name: Brand & polish
portals.description: Brand chrome and effects from your presets when the job includes them.

portals.name: Publish
portals.description: Publish to connected accounts (YouTube, TikTok, and more) with job metadata. Skipped when the job is preview-only.

content_types.name: Peaks Shorts
content_types.description: High-signal moments from YouTube Most Replayed, Twitch chat peaks, and Kick CCV peaks, produced as Shorts.

content_types.name: Captions, brand, QA
content_types.description: The Short pipeline polishes and checks before publish from the member portal.

content_types.name: Direct publish
content_types.description: Connect accounts once. Ship from the job instead of re-uploading by hand.

content_types.name: More in the portal
content_types.description: Extra job tools stay in-app. Managed add-ons are available by inquiry when ordered for your workflow.

pipeline_sub: Portals run when the job spec says so. Skipped is not failed.
content_types_sub: Peaks means Most Replayed, chat spikes, and CCV first. Extra tools live in the member portal.
features_sub: Peaks (Most Replayed, chat, CCV), jobs, channels, social accounts, review queue, and billing at app.auraflux.co.
credits_body: The AuraFlux plan includes 400 credits per month. Credits are consumed when production runs. Buy packs in-app if you need more mid-cycle. Managed capacity is scoped when you inquire.
publish_sub: Connect accounts in the app. Publish from the job instead of re-uploading by hand.
